textTemplates.name: Body_24hrs
textTemplates.text:
Dear {!$Record.Service_Request__r.Owner:User.FirstName},
Service Request {!FetchServiceRequestRecord_24hrs.Name} assigned to {!$Record.Service_Request__r.Owner:User.FirstName} {!$Record.Service_Request__r.Owner:User.LastName} has shown no activity in the past 24 hours. Please start work or update the request status accordingly.
Best regards, Modon

textTemplates.name: Body_48hrs
textTemplates.text:
Dear {!$Record.Service_Request__r.Owner:User.FirstName},
This email serves as a formal escalation. The Service Request ({!$Record.Service_Request__r.Name}) assigned to {!$Record.Service_Request__r.Owner:User.FirstName} {!$Record.Service_Request__r.Owner:User.LastName} is 48 hours overdue and remains uncreated. We are concerned this could affect SLAs or downstream processes.
Please address this as a priority and confirm the status.
Best regards, Modon

textTemplates.name: Body_72Hrs
textTemplates.text:
Dear {!$Record.Service_Request__r.Owner:User.FirstName},
Service Request {!FetchServiceRequestRecord_72rs.Name} is approaching its SLA limit (72 hours since creation). Please take action to ensure timely resolution and closure. If already addressed, please update the status accordingly.
Best regards, Modon

textTemplates.name: Body_immediately
textTemplates.text:
Hi {!$Record.Service_Request__r.Owner:User.FirstName},
This is to inform you that Service Request {!$Record.Service_Request__r.Name} has been assigned to you as the request owner. Please review the details and begin work on this request at your earliest convenience. Your timely response is essential to ensure SLA compliance and customer satisfaction.
Best re﻿gards, Modon
